title: Heavy-tier harness 2/5: exit-code table + pre-flight (COULDNT_RUN via run-root side channel)
description:
Piece 2 of LIN-4219's approved plan: one exit-code table and one pre-flight, so that "couldn't run" never reads as "0 failed" or "killed". **Blocked by piece 1 (nested environment).**

## Slice of the approved plan — implemented (pruned at close-out)

Implemented as approved in PR [#319](<https://github.com/JKershaw/simple-dispatcher/pull/319>), merged as `90bbf82`: `exit-codes.js` (`COULDNT_RUN = 75`) and `preflight.js` (`preflight` / `preflightOrThrow`, named needs `harbour`/`ports`/`git`), preflight in both runner `main`s and in `systemSuite.before` / `startHarbour`, the run-root `preflight.jsonl` side channel read by `isolate-run.js` (`COULDNT_RUN` wins over exit 1), `runKiller` `couldnt-run` outcome (never `killed`), the shared `Harbour: <dir> @ <sha>[ dirty]` line, and childEnv for nested envs. Deviations from the plan: none in behaviour; three small leaf additions (`gap-report.js`, `harbour-summary.js`, 3 childEnv migrations). The plan's witnesses are in `test/preflight-wiring.test.js` and `test/harbour-locate.test.js`, including the killer-shaped single-file witness added at close-out (`ec42058`). The full pre-prune description is preserved in the task snapshots and the comment trail.

## Acceptance

* Parent "Done when" items covered here: **"Couldn't run" is never "0 failed"**, **one report**, and **the run's summary names which Harbour checkout and commit**.
* The witnesses above pass in `npm test`. `test:system` and `test:mutation` run green with Harbour present.
* **Likeliest break (plan):** pre-flight reads green while a file still starts, because (b) was missed on some path. The single-file and killer witnesses exercise that path on purpose.

---

**Parent:** LIN-4219 — *simple-dispatcher: the heavy test tier stands on one harness*. The parent's description holds the full scope, the "Done when" and "At merge" lists, the layout table and the **Implementation Plan**. Its comment trail holds the approving `### Plan Review Verdict` (comment `4ea51c1c-fa0a-44b9-9a63-c614f8fd7f56`). Read both before starting.

**Starting point:** the parent's approved plan is where this piece starts. Read it in full in LIN-4219's description, under "Implementation Plan". Follow it. Where the code shows it is wrong, change course and say so in a comment on LIN-4219.

Session fit: fits one session
Plan-review due: no — covered by LIN-4219's approving plan-review (comment 4ea51c1c-fa0a-44b9-9a63-c614f8fd7f56, rev 1; the verdict names no revision number, and this is the only plan revision and the only verdict on the trail)
Grounding commit: simple-dispatcher `main` @ `502901c` (plan and review both grounded here; re-checked at breakdown on 2026-11-04, and nothing under `test/`, `docs/testing-and-ci.md`, `package.json` or `e2e-smoke.js` has changed)

**Constraints from the parent (all pieces):** nothing new at the repo root. `signal-guard.js` and `protected-paths.js` stay untouched. Each piece is its own PR, with its own run of `npm test`, plus `test:system` / `test:mutation` where the piece touches them. Out of scope, for the parent's close-out to list (not file): a scheduled/CI heavy-tier run (LIN-3160), pinned Harbour per dispatcher commit, splitting `run-mutations.js`, a test-infra module map, `e2e-smoke.js` joining the tier, the shared source sandbox.

comments.body:
PR: https://github.com/JKershaw/simple-dispatcher/pull/319 (branch feat/lin-4221-exit-codes-preflight, targets main)
Head SHA: fb72a2f1ba43397a06560a748022bcc7622c3d98

CI (workflow CI, job "unit tests", ubuntu, `npm ci` + `npm test`): pass on the head SHA (run 41837797404). Node summary: 4168 tests, 4161 pass, 0 fail, 7 skipped (the macOS-only suites skip off-darwin).
- The first CI run on dd23398 (run 41836948604) failed one test, "a clean run is unchanged" in test/preflight-wiring.test.js: on a /tmp TMPDIR the inner run's leak trap counted the fixture's own read as a shared-temp leak. Reproduced locally with TMPDIR=/private/tmp; fixed in fb72a2f by pinning the inner trap's shared roots to an empty private dir. Full npm test under TMPDIR=/private/tmp: 4177 pass, 0 fail, 5 skipped.

Local (macOS): npm test 4177 pass, 0 fail, 5 skipped. npm run test:mutation 67/67, exit 0.

npm run test:system: 138 pass, 2 fail. The two failures are PRE-EXISTING: they fail identically on a clean origin/main checkout (same Harbour checkout, same test names), and they are not weakened or skipped.
- test/system/observation-feed.test.js: "a completed standalone run appears as a terminal session in the Sessions view"
- test/system/tap1-openrouter.test.js: "generating a run summary drives Harbour's real OpenRouter client to the fake (not the mock)"
CI does not run test:system, so these do not turn the PR check red.

Follow-up (separate ticket, not in this PR): in-process process.env writes at test/system/harness/dispatcher.js:87 (DISPATCH_API_URL) and test/system/harbour-stop.test.js:65/69 (HARBOUR_DIR save/restore). These change the test process's own environment, which children inherit. They are not nested-env construction, so the childEnv audit does not cover them.

Not done here: the issue is not set to Done, and the PR is not merged. Review and close-out come later.

**Autopilot (stepper) run summary — implementation arc for LIN-4221**

4 beats in one warm worker session (ROOT dispatch `3df58197-8cfe-4cae-a1cc-2b2578dd093a`), all judged on evidence before advancing:
1. exit-codes.js + preflight.js with characterization + red-witness/break-and-restore tests (`da671f1`).
2. Runner wiring, startHarbour chokepoint, run-root `preflight.jsonl` side channel, runKiller `couldnt-run` outcome (`1447b14`). Challenge raised: the 2 failing `test:system` tests were only compared to beat 1.
3. Rebased onto main (LIN-4223), baseline-diffed the 2 failures BY NAME on clean origin/main (identical → pre-existing), shared `Harbour:` summary line, childEnv audit + migration of 3 sites (`dd23398`).
4. Pushed, PR opened, CI checked (`fb72a2f`).

Evidence: PR https://github.com/JKershaw/simple-dispatcher/pull/319 (open, mergeable, head fb72a2f). CI `unit tests` passed on head (the first run on dd23398 failed one new test under a /tmp TMPDIR; worker reproduced and fixed it). Local: npm test 4177 pass/0 fail, test:mutation 67/67, test:system 138 pass/2 fail (same 2 fail on clean main; CI does not run test:system).

Left: independent `review`, then `close-out`. Not merged, not Done. Flagged follow-up: in-process process.env writes (dispatcher.js:87, harbour-stop.test.js:65/69). Note: a worker edit briefly landed in a different checkout and was reverted (verified clean).

## Review — LIN-4221

PR https://github.com/JKershaw/simple-dispatcher/pull/319, reviewed at head `fb72a2f1ba43397a06560a748022bcc7622c3d98` (base main @ `54febbf`).

CI: green. The workflow `CI` / `unit tests` (`npm ci` + `npm test`, ubuntu) passed on fb72a2f (run 41837797404). CI does not run `test:system` or `test:mutation`. I ran both locally; results below.

### Scope vs plan
The changed files match the plan slice: `exit-codes.js`, `preflight.js`, the runner wiring, `startHarbour`, `systemSuite.before`, the `isolate-run.js` exit handler, and `runKiller`/`exitCodeFor`. There are three additions:
- `gap-report.js`: a pure leaf, so `isolate-run.js` does not have to load net or child_process.
- `harbour-summary.js`: the shared home for `shortCommit`, which the plan asked for.
- 3 childEnv migrations (`harbour.js` spawn, `run-system.js` spawn, `harbour-stop.test.js`): this is the plan's "build any nested env through childEnv".

None of the three overruns the plan. `signal-guard.js` and `protected-paths.js` are untouched. Nothing new at the repo root.

### Regression check
`git log -30` on the touched files: LIN-4180 (#308) promised a plain "can't find Harbour" message. It is intact: the runner still prints the `formatLocateMessage` text, now as the gap's fix, and `harbour-locate.test.js` still asserts it. LIN-4223's group stop (`detached`, `recordGroup`) in `harbour.js` is intact. LIN-4220's childEnv modes are used as designed. `run-system.js` no longer exports `shortCommit`, and nothing else imported it. No changes to these paths since the ticket was created other than #317/#318, which this branch is rebased on.

### Requirements, verified
- **COULDNT_RUN = 75, one table, used by both runners.** Yes.
- **preflight(harbour|ports|git).** Checks every need, reports each gap once with its fix, and never throws for a gap. An unknown need is a TypeError. `harbour-locate.js` stays the only authority on the checkout. Yes, covered by unit tests, including the all-missing case.
- **(a) Runner `main` preflight before any spawn.**
  - `run-system`: exit 75, empty stdout (witness updated from exit 1 to 75 in `harbour-locate.test.js`).
  - `run-mutations`: exit 75, and the `located.kind !== 'found'` path returns 75.
- **(b) systemSuite `before` and `startHarbour` (load-bearing), plus the side channel.**
  - I ran it by hand the way a killer would: `HARBOUR_DIR=/definitely/not node --require ./test/isolate-run.js --require ./test/state-cache-trap.js --test test/system/close-on-done.test.js` (a systemSuite file) exits 75, and `test/system/boot.test.js` (calls startHarbour directly) exits 75.
  - In both runs `isolate-run` prints the gap once with its fix.
  - `scriptedRun` (harness/run.js) goes through startHarbour, so it is covered.
- **Leak plus gap.** Both are printed and 75 wins.
- **Mutation gate.** A killer exit of 75, in the baseline or mid-run, gives `couldnt-run`: no score, exit 75, never killed.
- **Harbour line.** Both runners print `Harbour: <dir> @ <sha>[ dirty]`; observed in both runs below. The unit tier prints none.

### Mutation checks (LIN-2274), every one reverted afterwards; tree is clean
| Mutation | Result |
|---|---|
| M1: isolate-run ignores `preflight.jsonl` (`gaps = []`) | **red**, 3 tests (side-channel exit 75, distinct-gap print, leak+gap) |
| M2: drop the mid-run `r.code === EXIT.COULDNT_RUN` branch in runMutations | **red**: "a killer that exits 75 … never scored as killed" |
| M3: startHarbour uses `preflight` with a plain throw instead of `preflightOrThrow` (no side channel) | **red**, 2 tests |
| M4: isolate-run prints gaps without `distinctGaps` | **red**: "prints each distinct gap once" |
| M5: leak exit (1) wins over a gap | **red**: "COULDNT_RUN wins over 1" |

M3 also discharges the plan's "skip-mutation" witness: turning the check into a non-recording check sends the witness red, so the check is not advisory. Not mutated: the `preflightOrThrow` in `systemSuite.before`. It is deliberately redundant with startHarbour, which covers that path.

### Heavy tier, run by me on fb72a2f (macOS, Harbour = sibling LinearViewer @ eb44eff9)
- `npm run test:mutation`: Mutation score 67/67 (100%), exit 0.
- `npm run test:system`: 138 pass, 2 fail, exit 1. The failures, by name:
  - "a completed standalone run appears as a terminal session in the Sessions view" (observation-feed.test.js)
  - "generating a run summary drives Harbour's real OpenRouter client to the fake (not the mock)" (tap1-openrouter.test.js)
  
  I re-ran those two files on clean `origin/main` @ 54febbf with the same Harbour. Both tests fail there by the same names, so they are pre-existing and not caused by this PR.

### Findings
1. **Missing witness: a real system file run the killer way.** The plan names this witness: "Spawn a single system file the way a killer would, with Harbour missing, and assert the same exit". It is not in the suite. `test/preflight-wiring.test.js:21` declares `BOOT_FILE` and never uses it. The nearest test runs startHarbour from a `-e` script under the preload, not `node --test <system file>` through `systemSuite`. I confirmed the behaviour by hand (above), but the plan calls this "the likeliest break", so it needs a test that stays in the suite. Fix for close-out: in `test/preflight-wiring.test.js`, add a case to the `isolate-run.js reads preflight.jsonl` describe (or its own describe):
   - `runParent(BOOT_FILE, { tmp: tempDir('boot-killer'), set: { HARBOUR_DIR: MISSING_HARBOUR } })`
   - assert `r.status === 75`
   - assert `/Missing harbour: no usable Harbour checkout/` appears exactly once in `r.stderr`
   - optionally the same for `test/system/close-on-done.test.js`, which covers the systemSuite `before` path.

   Expected to pass as-is, because my manual run of the same command exited 75.
2. **Minor: the "no test file started" check is weaker than the plan's marker.** The witness checks `stdout === ''`, not a marker written at file start. That is sound here, because preflight returns before `spawn` and any spawned `node --test` would write to stdout. No change required.
3. **Minor dead code.** In `run-mutations.js` `main`, the `located.kind !== 'found'` branch after `pre.ok` can no longer be reached. It is harmless and returns 75 as required. Optional cleanup.

### Isolated, or one of a class?
The class is "a heavy-tier entry that can start work without a prerequisite check". Its instances:
- The runner mains: handled.
- systemSuite and startHarbour: handled.
- scriptedRun: handled through startHarbour.
- The baseline (`git` need): piece 5, LIN-4224.
- Fixed ports (`ports` need): piece 3, LIN-4222. Today no caller passes `fixedPorts`, so it is unused until then.
- `e2e-smoke.js`: out of scope, listed in the parent.

No unhandled sibling inside this ticket's classes. The implementer flagged in-process `process.env` writes (dispatcher.js:87, harbour-stop.test.js:65/69). Those are **outside**: they are not nested-env construction or preflight. Close-out checks for an existing ticket before filing.

### What CI Did Not Prove
- **Inside (preflight at the per-file level, the plan's "likeliest break"): a real system file run as a killer exits 75 with Harbour missing.** CI has no witness for it (finding 1). Before the merge, close-out adds the `BOOT_FILE` witness described in finding 1 and confirms it passes. It must go red if `startHarbour` stops calling `preflightOrThrow` (the M3 mutation). The manual run by review passed (exit 75).
- **Inside (acceptance): `test:system` and `test:mutation` with Harbour present.** CI does not run the heavy tier. Discharged by review's local run on fb72a2f: mutation 67/67 exit 0. System had 138 pass and 2 failures, both shown to be pre-existing by name on clean main. Close-out re-runs `test:mutation`, and `test:system` (expecting only those 2 named failures), if the head moves past fb72a2f.
- **Outside: the 2 pre-existing `test:system` failures** (observation-feed "terminal session in the Sessions view"; tap1-openrouter "real OpenRouter client to the fake"). They fail on main @ 54febbf, so they are not this ticket's problem. They do block a literally green `test:system`. Close-out checks whether a ticket exists (LIN-4224's scripted baseline may own them) and files one if not.
- **Outside: in-process `process.env` writes** (dispatcher.js:87, harbour-stop.test.js:65/69), as the implementer flagged. Close-out files this after a duplicate check.
- **Inside, discharged: the exit code 75 survives `node --test` via the preload on this host's node.** Shown by the passing side-channel tests in CI (ubuntu) and locally (macOS), and by review's manual killer-shaped run.

### Verdict
Approve — conditional on close-out discharging the ledger. The implementation meets the plan and its load-bearing tests survive mutation. The one remaining piece is the killer-shaped single-file witness (finding 1), a small test-only addition.

## Close-out — LIN-4221

**Merged:** PR https://github.com/JKershaw/simple-dispatcher/pull/319, squash-merged as `90bbf82` on main, pinned with `--match-head-commit ec420583cd7950dce6d11ed327b565fd7f829f3b`. No deploy (test-harness code only), so there are no post-deploy steps.

**Review verdict:** Approve (conditional on the ledger), at `fb72a2f`.

### Changes I made after approval
| Commit | Change | Answers |
|---|---|---|
| `ec42058` | `test/preflight-wiring.test.js`: two cases that run a REAL system file the killer way (`node --require isolate-run.js --test <file>`, `HARBOUR_DIR` missing): `boot.test.js` (startHarbour direct) and `close-on-done.test.js` (systemSuite `before`). Each asserts exit 75 and the gap printed exactly once. Test-only. | Review finding 1 / "What CI did not prove" (inside) |

Findings 2 (marker check weaker than plan, "no change required") and 3 (unreachable `located.kind !== 'found'` branch, "optional cleanup") were left as review marked them. No citation or comment was made stale by this change.

### Ledger
* **Inside: killer-shaped witness.** Done (`ec42058`). Mutation M3 re-run by me (`startHarbour` calls plain `preflight` + throw instead of `preflightOrThrow`): the `boot.test.js` witness went RED (plus the 2 existing side-channel tests: 3 fail, 8 pass). Restored; tree clean. The `close-on-done` case stays green under M3 because `systemSuite.before` also calls `preflightOrThrow` (deliberate redundancy, as review noted), so `boot.test.js` is the case that pins `startHarbour`.
* **Inside: `test:system` / `test:mutation` with Harbour present** (head moved past `fb72a2f`, so re-run on `ec42058`, Harbour = LinearViewer @ eb44eff9): `test:mutation` score 67/67 (100%); I did not capture its exit code in my pipe. `test:system` 138 pass, 2 fail, and the 2 failures are exactly the two named pre-existing ones.
* **Inside, discharged by review:** exit 75 survives `node --test` via the preload (CI ubuntu + macOS + review's manual run).
* **Outside: 2 pre-existing `test:system` failures.** Already tracked: LIN-4187 (observation-feed) and LIN-4188 (tap1-openrouter); linked as `related`, no new ticket.
* **Outside: in-process `process.env` writes** (dispatcher.js:87, harbour-stop.test.js:63-70). No existing ticket found (searched by file and finding). Filed LIN-4227 (Medium, label Improvement), related to this ticket.
* **Named monitor/rollback:** review named none; none claimed.

### CI
No CI gap. `CI / unit tests` (npm ci + npm test, ubuntu) is SUCCESS on `ec42058` (run 41839651093). Local `npm test`: 4184 tests, 4179 pass, 0 fail, 5 skipped. CI does not run `test:system`/`test:mutation`; see the local runs above. Not proven: an author-independent run of the heavy tier.

### Housekeeping
Description archived (snapshot confirmed in `/issues/LIN-4221/snapshots`) and pruned to a stub; problem statement, acceptance, session-fit and plan-review lines kept verbatim. Post-deploy checks not run: none applicable.
